name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Two parties agree to protect each other's confidential information shared for a defined purpose.

fields.label: Purpose of disclosure
fields.help: The business purpose for which confidential information is shared.

sections.title: Parties
sections.text: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective_date}} between {{party_a_name}}, located at {{party_a_address}} ("Party A"), and {{party_b_name}}, located at {{party_b_address}} ("Party B"). Each party may act as a "Disclosing Party" or a "Receiving Party".

sections.title: Purpose
sections.text: The parties wish to exchange certain confidential information for the following purpose (the "Purpose"): {{purpose}}.

sections.title: Confidential Information
sections.text: "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether orally, in writing or by any other means, that is marked confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.text: Confidential Information does not include information that the Receiving Party can show: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully known to the Receiving Party before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without restriction; or (d) is independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

sections.title: Obligations of the Receiving Party
sections.text: The Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose; (b) not disclose it to any third party except to its employees, advisers and contractors who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement; and (c) protect it with at least the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information, and no less than reasonable care.

sections.title: Compelled Disclosure
sections.text: If the Receiving Party is required by law or court order to disclose Confidential Information, it shall, where legally permitted, give the Disclosing Party prompt written notice and cooperate in seeking protective measures, and shall disclose only the portion legally required.

sections.title: Return or Destruction
sections.text: Upon written request or termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so.

sections.title: Term and Survival
sections.text: This Agreement remains in effect for {{term_years}} year(s) from the effective date. The obligations of confidentiality survive for {{survival_years}} year(s) after expiration or termination.

sections.title: No License or Warranty
sections.text: All Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party. No license is granted by this Agreement. Confidential Information is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind.

sections.title: Remedies
sections.text: Each party acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be inadequate, and that the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive relief in addition to any other available remedy.

sections.title: General
sections.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}. It is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties. If any provision is unenforceable, the remainder stays in effect.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.text: Signed by the duly authorized representatives of {{party_a_name}} and {{party_b_name}}.
